top_signal.title: EU Startup candle business, vessels??
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone!   I’m in the early stages of starting my own candle business in the Netherlands. I’m excited about the idea, but there’s quite a lot I’m still trying to figure out… 😶   One of my biggest challenges right now is finding suppliers for the candle vessels themselves. I’m looking for something a little different from standard glass jars, but I’m struggling to find the right manufacturers or suppliers. Where do you even start looking for these kinds of products? Are there particular platforms, suppliers or sourcing agents you’d recommend?   I’m also unsure whether it’s better to source and manufacture in Europe or overseas. Since I plan to sell in the EU, product safety regulations are another important consideration, especially for candles and their containers.  And then there’s packaging. How do you achieve a premium look without spending too much when you’re just starting out?   I’d really love to hear from anyone who’s started a physical product business. Any advice, experiences or things you wish you’d known at the beginning would mean a lot.   🤗Thanks in advance!       submitted by     /u/Whctevs       [link]       [comments]
